task: Google Contacts (the person's own account): export all contacts as a vCard file with Google's own Export feature, so the bot can seed the BehalfBot CRM. No scraping

steps.human: Sign in to the Google account whose contacts you want to bring over. Press Done when you see your contact list.

steps.do: Open Export: tick any contact, then Selection actions > All, then More actions > Export. In the dialog choose vCard (the Google CSV option also works). Do not press Export.

steps.human: Check the dialog says it will export your contacts. Press Export yourself, then Done. The file lands in your Downloads folder.

accept: A contacts.vcf (or contacts.csv) is in the person's Downloads. They send that file to the bot, which runs chassis/scripts/crm_import.py on it, dry run first.
notes: Only the contacts list page: never open Gmail, other Google apps or a contact's detail page.
Sign-in runs on accounts.google.com, which is deliberately off the allow list, so the extension lets go of the tab while the person signs in.
Google's labels move: if Selection actions is not there, the left sidebar's Export entry opens the same dialog. Labels checked against support.google.com/contacts/answer/7199294 on 2026-11-20.
No save_secret step: nothing here creates a credential.
